content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need some advice for my project setup: I have 2 analog inputs for temperature and humidity, 5 digital inputs, 3 digital outputs, and an HMI panel. Which hardware would be suitable, and what configuration would you recommend for this application? Thank you.
Hi, You could check out the [product_name] [version_no]. It has the features you need and can connect with an HMI panel or [product_name] operator device.

Thanks for your suggestion. I downloaded the datasheet for the [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]), but noticed the inputs can't be directly configured for 4-20 mA signals. Appreciate your help.
That's correct. To handle 4-20 mA inputs, you need to use the appropriate [product_name] expansion module.
Hi [user_name], I typically work with the [version_no] for 4-20 mA applications. You just need to add a 500 Ohm resistor to the analog input to make it compatible.

analysis.insight_summary: A user requested guidance on selecting suitable automation hardware for a project involving analog and digital inputs/outputs with an HMI panel. The main concern was that the recommended [product_name] ([version_no]) doesn’t natively support 4-20 mA analog inputs, leading to confusion about compatibility. Community members clarified that additional expansion modules or a resistor are needed for 4-20 mA input support, revealing a usability gap and lack of straightforward product guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking hardware that natively supports 4-20 mA analog inputs, integrates easily with digital I/O and an HMI panel, and requires minimal additional configuration.
